_comment: Hand-pinned canonical artist names. The key is the name to replace, the
value is the name to use. Matching is case- and diacritic-insensitive, so
This exists for artists whose different spellings are genuinely the same
performer. artist_names.py also derives aliases automatically from
MusicBrainz artist MBIDs, which is the preferred route -- this file is for
what MusicBrainz does not cover, or disagrees with.
MusicBrainz covers almost no Balkan artist: their recordings carry no
artist MBID here, so the automatic route cannot merge their spellings and
the pin below is the only thing that will.
A pin also decides the direction when MusicBrainz disagrees. MusicBrainz
renamed Colson Baker to 'mgk'; 'Machine Gun Kelly' is pinned because that
is the name to show. Matching ignores case and diacritics but not a dot,
so 'Mr.Black' and 'Mr. Black' each need their own line.
